name: - SKYWALKER OG - 7G 40's Infused Flower
description:
SW and OG Kush - SW OG is an indica with earthy and diesel-forward notes.

Elevate your experience with STIIIZY's new 40’s infused flower. We have expanded our 40’s line by incorporating our premium cannabis flower infused with our finest THC-A Diamonds. We call them 40's because our infused flower strains are testing around 40% +/- total cannabinoids. Now you can roll your own 40’s with STIIIZY infused flower.
